function: S81 field return gather: the 128 return-region roots (ot_v41_ret_root, D = QD = 128) of the field, fed by the column return trunks; forwards finished rows per root to the capture and the VM control words to the capture

inputs.trunks: rW0..5 / rE0..5 (generator ports unchanged): lane j = bits [69j +: 69] = {rr 68 = {fault, busy, node word 66 = {e, d32, t32, v}}, meso valid}; top 2 bits {fault, live}
inputs.lane_to_root_rule: lane j of r<half><tier> = frame order[j] (farthest column first); frame index = root/region index; identical on the head die
inputs.f_vm: see generator change G5 (serial domain, captured at the pin, ratio CDC to stream)

protocol: valid-only, no backpressure toward the field (as the field); the VM issues a phase word only after the capture status shows drained/idle (the spine waits capture_drained); a phase word the capture cannot take is a protocol fault
boundary: every die input captured in a flop at the pin, every output launched from a flop; reset synchronised per domain, 8 kept reset copies per 128 roots

generator_changes.what: dsfd_sp_gather / dsfd_sp_capture become REAL views (their LEF pins), placed abutting: gather (S) -> capture -> VM (N); the gather->capture and capture->VM buses are abutment nets, not hub-bus stations
generator_changes.why: 6,947-b and 13,376-b buses; the rows of a phase leave every root at once (I66 trace: 576 rows in 6 edges, 128 writers/edge), so the return path must carry one row per root per stream cycle

generator_changes.layout: per root r (0..127) [53r +: 53] = {e, pos3, row16, fp32 32, v}; [6784 +: 160] = control word {f_vm[159:1], v}; [6944 +: 3] = {live, busy, fault}
per root r [104r +: 104] = {row1 {data32, addr19}, v1, row0 {data32, addr19}, v0} (row0 older); [13312 +: 64] = status {busy, live, 0, identity47, phase10, fault, drained, idle, live}

generator_changes.why: the serial-domain crossings (VM->gather control, capture->VM writes) are inside the views (ot_ratio_cdc_fifo); the r9 hub buses vm->gather and capture->vm cross serial/stream with no CDC

generator_changes.layout: [0] v, [2:1] kind (0 phase, 1 reset-request level), [49:3] identity47, [59:50] phase_id10, [89:60] obase30, [119:90] ops30, [122:120] np, [124:123] fmt, [140:125] rsplit16, [141] fp32_low, [142] fp32_high, [158:143] phase_rows16, [159] reset_request level; rest 0

generator_changes.why: per-root rd64 capture + 2-row pair packer + ratio CDC (128 x DEPTH 4 x 103 b) and 20.3k pins

generator_changes.new_um: set by the root sub-block route (128 x ot_s81ph_root_blk, ROOTD 128: the S81 physical return contract keeps ROOTD 128; ~2.15 Mbit of root storage)
generator_changes.why: the 128 region roots of ot_v41_field_w17w10 are not on the die in r9: the column FIFO carries the column top NODE word

generator_changes.what: glue (dsfd_cfifo): column status {fault, busy} is carried only with a valid return word (the meso FIFO forwards data only when w_v = root valid); a column fault with no following word is not reported. Carry status on an always-valid sideband or OR it into the trunk {fault, live} bits
